bash.name: bash
bash.description: Execute a bash command with timeout and working directory support. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

params.description: A 5-10 word description of what this command does
params.timeout: Timeout in milliseconds (default: 120000 / 2 minutes, max: 600000 / 10 minutes)
params.cwd: Working directory to execute the command in (optional)

name: Bash (Admin)
description: Execute bash commands directly on the host system. Admin-only access for system administration tasks.

changelog.notes: Initial release — run shell commands on the host server, with timeouts and a chosen working directory
